original_contracts.source_acceptance: Guest linking, account recovery, export, deletion and divergent-save selection preserve recovery copies and purchased ownership.
Unique receipts and idempotent grants separate cosmetics, Support allowance, pass XP and gameplay saves; interrupted grants resume safely.
Preview, price, ownership, restoration, selected pass and archived completion are understandable; shared XP grants only once.
Validate, grant, acknowledge, restore and reconcile purchases; pending, duplicate, refunded and interrupted cases have explicit states.
Ad and briefing routes consume the same allowance; no-fill, refusal and duplicate callbacks preserve access and cannot multiply rewards.
Every content ID and reward is reachable; full pass is completable free of paid speed; no event or cosmetic increases core power.
Data inventory matches SDK behavior; consent refusal, export/deletion and service-outage recovery are verified on actual builds.
Validate economy/session events, entitlement dashboards, alerts, backups, support receipts and feature disable switches in staging.
Simulate 30/90 days across visit and bonus policies, audit Note sinks and content pacing, freeze beta config and metric definitions.
Purchase/restore/refund/ad callbacks are tested under packet loss, retries, duplicate messages, crashes and backend outages.
Exercise service load, support recovery, purchase reconciliation and feature disable controls with real opt-in testers.
A real 28-day pass and mature D30 cohort are observed; accelerated testing is documented separately.
Exercise season archive, paid pass continuation, save migration, purchase replay and compatible rollback/forward repair.
Version-compatible config rollback, feature disables, capacity, backups and entitlement replay are rehearsed and documented.
Screenshots, footage, credits, help visuals and release assets describe the actual shipped game and offers.
All gate evidence is linked; no blocker, save-loss, duplication or unresolved purchase-delivery issue remains.
Recheck current platform requirements, provide reviewer access and working products, and resolve review findings before launch.
Document 14-day coverage, escalation, incident response and Season 2 preparation; launch authority and rollout stop conditions are explicit.
